We deal in veterinary profession and create practical content to make people aware about animal's feeding, care and management, diseases and future prospects. We are dedicate to uplift standards of animal living and saving them from hunger, thirst and pain, and providing them conducive environment. Our goals are to explore insights in veterinary profession and share them to other veterinary professionals and common people so that society may benefit. Our utmost priority is domesticated animals and small farmers and pet keepers because this portion of society has no access to quality service and qualified veterinarians. We are sharing our personal experiences and practical knowledge from literature so that the professionals may get benefit and apply this workble ideas for the wellfare of unspeakable creature and also for the poor people striving for their survival in this fast moving era. You people are requested to share.
